pages.text: The hang glider is self explanatory. Hold it in your hand and click to place it on your back. Now jump!$(br)To increase your speed you can press shift while gliding, but watch out, you'll lose altitude faster!$(br)$(br)Your hang glider now
pages.title: item.openblocks.hang_glider

pages.text: also includes an acoustic variometer indicating vertical air movement. Press V to activate it and stay up forever (or until the sun goes down)!
